root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: When `ci.min == 0 && ci.min_is_sure != 0`, every `BAG_MEMORY` node in the look-behind body must satisfy `(NODE_IS_BACKREF(node) || NODE_IS_CALLED(node)) == 0` before `onig_node_reset_empty(node)` may run.
root_cause_criterion.criterion: The empty-look-behind rewrite is only safe when the look-behind body contains no capture node already marked as backreferenced or called. Otherwise the in-place reset would free a node that a resolved `NODE_CALL_BODY` or backreference path can still reach later in the same compile.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original resets the empty look-behind even though the capture node inside that subtree is already marked CALLED by the later `\g'1'`. The fixed image computes this aggregate predicate as `used` inside `check_node_in_look_behind(..., &used)` and adds `&& used == FALSE` before `onig_node_reset_empty(node)`.

nodes.state: Before `tune_tree()` begins, the call node for `\g'1'` stores the capture group's `BAG_MEMORY` node directly in `NODE_CALL_BODY(cn)`.
The empty-look-behind rewrite frees the exact `BAG_MEMORY` node still aliased by the resolved call body pointer.
The `NODE_CALL` case in `quantifiers_memory_node_info()` follows `NODE_BODY(node)` through the stale call-body alias after the empty-look-behind rewrite has already freed the capture node.
A recursive `quantifiers_memory_node_info()` invocation re-enters on the freed capture node and reads `NODE_TYPE(node)` at the AddressSanitizer-reported heap-use-after-free sink.

edges.relation: The exact capture-group pointer stored in `NODE_CALL_BODY(cn)` is one of the nodes recursively freed when `tune_look_behind()` rewrites the empty look-behind.
After the empty-look-behind rewrite frees the capture node, the later `NODE_CALL` case in `quantifiers_memory_node_info()` still dereferences that same pointer through its stale call-body alias.
The exact pointer chosen as the `NODE_CALL` body is passed unchanged into the recursive `quantifiers_memory_node_info()` invocation that executes the sink `switch (NODE_TYPE(node))`.
